description: This file contains the PHP class 'CustomerApproval' which is part of the Opencart admin module for handling customer approval operations such as fetching approvals, deleting approvals, and updating approval status.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Model class for managing customer approval data, including retrieval, deletion, and status updates.

methods.name: deleteApprovalsByCustomerId
methods.description: Deletes customer approval entries for a given customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer approvals with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: getCustomerApproval
methods.description: Fetches a specific customer approval record by its approval ID.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer approvals based on filtering criteria.

methods.name: approveCustomer
methods.description: Approves a customer by setting their status to active.

methods.name: denyCustomer
methods.description: Denies a customer by removing their approval record.

methods.name: approveAffiliate
methods.description: Approves an affiliate by updating their status.

methods.name: denyAffiliate
methods.description: Denies an affiliate by deleting their approval record.
